name: review-day
summary: Review the loops each day, critique the evidence and ask a person to approve at most one reversible improvement.

points.question: Where should the reviewed report go?

options.label: Post after the privacy check
options.summary: Post the critiqued report and label only that new issue cloving: review.
options.change: Keep postAfterPrivacy as postReport from review-day/post.ts in review-day.ts. Configure privateTexts with at least one nonblank item.

options.label: Keep in the run result
options.summary: Return the report without posting a review issue.
options.change: Remove the postReport import and await postReport(input, text) call from review-day.ts. Remove create-issue from methods.github. If next.nothing is also selected, remove github from capabilities and remove methods.github. Set selection.post to result in review-day/scenarios.ts.

points.question: What happens after one proposal is approved?

options.label: Hand to idea-to-issue
options.summary: Wait for the ticket and label only that new issue cloving: improvement.
options.change: Keep handoffProposal as nextProposal from review-day/next.ts in review-day.ts and idea-to-issue in workflow.handoffs. Copy idea-to-issue into the private workflow folder and select its next.nothing option so it neither starts development nor adds cloving: ready.

options.label: Do nothing after approval
options.summary: Record the decision without starting another workflow or changing any issue.
options.change: Remove the nextProposal import from review-day.ts. Replace the chooseProposal assignment and the conditional nextProposal call with await chooseProposal(input, report.proposals). Set workflow.handoffs to [] and selection.next to nothing in review-day/scenarios.ts. If post.result is selected, remove github from capabilities and remove methods.github.
